categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Fuzzing label, modifies the miniscript fuzz harness to fix timelock value generation.
categories.rationale: Fixes a typo in the fuzz harness upper bound that prevented fuzzers from generating time-based after() expressions and exercising Miniscript type-mixing rules. The PR description notes that correcting the bound from 0x7FFFFFF to 0x7FFFFFFF increases libFuzzer edges from 8829 to 8841 on the existing corpus and enables coverage of previously unreachable branches in ComputeType.
